app.name: Tender Tracker
app.description: Tenders, the quotes gathered against them, and what was bid back.

error.title: This screen could not be loaded
error.explain: Something went wrong while fetching it. Trying again often works.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Tender Tracker is invitation-only. If you do not have an account yet, ask your Administrator to invite you.

error.invalid: That email and password do not match. Ask your Administrator to reset your password if you cannot remember it.
error.disabled: This account can no longer sign in. Ask your Administrator.
error.incomplete: Enter both your email and your password.
error.link: That invitation link has expired or has already been used. Ask your Administrator for a new one.

setPassword.title: Choose a password
setPassword.description: Welcome, {name}. Choose a password and you are in.

error.mismatch: Those two passwords are not the same.
error.no_session: That invitation link has expired or has already been used. Ask your Administrator for a new one.

setup.title: Create the first Administrator
setup.description: This app has no accounts yet. The account you create here is the one that can invite everyone else, and it can only be created once.
setup.name: Your name
setup.secretHint: The SETUP_SECRET configured on this deployment.

closed.title: Setup is already done
closed.description: This app already has an account, so the first Administrator cannot be created again. Sign in, or ask your Administrator to invite you.

error.closed: This app already has an account. Setup runs once and has already run.
error.wrong_secret: That setup secret is not right.
error.no_org: There is no organisation in the database. Apply the schema migrations first.
error.create_failed: The account could not be created. Nothing was saved — check the server logs and try again.
error.incomplete: Fill in every field, including the setup secret.
error.mismatch: Those two passwords are not the same.

chooseLanguage.title: Choose your language / 选择语言

images.unavailable: This picture could not be loaded.

error.not_found: That tender, item or picture is no longer there.
error.too_many: That is too many pictures at once. Add them in smaller batches.
error.too_large: One of those pictures is too big, even after shrinking. Keep each one under 10 MB.
error.not_an_image: One of those files is not a picture this app can store.
error.not_uploaded: One of those pictures did not finish uploading. Try again.
error.failed: That could not be saved. Try again.

myWork.title: My work
myWork.description: The items you still owe a price on. Enter a quote, or say you could not source it, and the row goes.
myWork.empty: Nothing outstanding. Every item you are sourcing has an answer against it.

tenders.title: Tenders
tenders.description: What needs doing, grouped by what is wrong with each tender.
tenders.empty: No tenders yet. Record the first one and it stops living in an inbox.
tenders.allClear: Nothing needs doing. Every tender here is either decided or written off.
tenders.recordDescription: What the client asked for, when it has to be back with them, and every product it asks for.
tenders.editDescription: The reference stays as issued. Items are added, changed and removed one at a time below.
tenders.internalQuoteHint: When assignees must have their suppliers' quotes in.
tenders.clientSubmissionHint: When our bid must reach the client. Missing it kills the tender.
tenders.expectedDecisionHint: Optional — clients rarely state one. Set it and the owner is reminded to chase the client that day.

submission_missed.title: Submission missed
submission_missed.hint: The bid never went out and the client's deadline has passed. It stays here until somebody records an outcome.

new.title: Not started
new.hint: Recorded, with nobody yet ringing suppliers.

sourcing.title: Sourcing
sourcing.hint: Assignees are getting prices in. Some items may still have nobody on them.

quoted.title: Quoted
quoted.hint: Every item has a price against it. These are waiting on somebody to pick and send the bid.

submitted.title: Submitted
submitted.hint: The bid is with the client. Nothing has gone wrong — this is where to chase them.

row.submissionMissed: Deadline passed {days, plural, =1 {# day} other {# days}} ago

client_submission.today: Bid due with the client today
client_submission.tomorrow: Bid due with the client tomorrow
client_submission.passed: Bid was due with the client {date}

outstanding.title: Waiting on you
outstanding.hint: You have neither entered a quote nor recorded no supplier found on these items.

yourItems.title: Items on this tender
yourItems.hint: Your own quotes are here. Comparing everyone's is the owner's job.

item.hint: A tender always asks for at least one product, and several is normal.

referenceImages.title: Reference images
referenceImages.hint: The pictures the client sent. Drop several in at once, then say which item each one is of.
referenceImages.unassigned: Not yet assigned to an item
referenceImages.openCount: Open {count, plural, =1 {# reference image} other {# reference images}} for {label}

error.forbidden: You are not signed in, or this is the owner's to change.
error.not_found: That tender is no longer there.
error.unassignable: That person cannot be given this tender — they may have left the team.
error.incomplete: Fill in the client, the title, and every field on each item.
error.invalid_date: Check the dates — one of them is not a real day.
error.deadlines_out_of_order: The internal quote deadline has to come on or before the client submission deadline.
error.no_items: A tender asks for at least one product. Add an item.
error.invalid_quantity: Give each item a quantity greater than zero.
error.last_item: This is the tender's only item, so it cannot be removed.
error.invalid_outcome: That is not an outcome that can be recorded against an item.
error.failed: That could not be saved. Try again.

sourcing.noSupplierFound: No supplier found — {count, plural, =1 {# assignee} other {# assignees}}

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.hint: What actually happened: that our bid went out, and what the client decided on each item.
outcome.notSubmitted: The bid has not gone out yet.
outcome.submittedHint: Recorded by hand. Once the client submission deadline has passed, nothing recorded here means the bid was never sent.
outcome.noOutcomeNote: The bid has not gone out.
outcome.awaitingDecisionNote: Submitted, with the client yet to rule on every item. Worth a chase.

explain.won: Every item that went to the client was won.
explain.lost: Every item that went to the client was lost.
explain.no_bid: Nothing on this tender was bid.

quotes.recorded: {count, plural, =1 {# quote recorded} other {# quotes recorded}}
quotes.none: Nothing recorded against this item yet.

yours.recorded: {count, plural, =1 {# quote from you} other {# quotes from you}}
yours.none: You have not recorded a quote on this item yet.

quotes.addHint: In the currency and the unit the supplier actually gave you. The conversion is ours to do, not yours.
quotes.notAssignee: Only an assignee can enter quotes on this tender — they are the one who rang the supplier. Add yourself below and the form appears.

matchType.label: What was priced
matchType.hint: An alternative is a different product from the one asked for. It carries its own name.

quotes.editHint: The currency cannot be changed here — it decides what the stored price means. If the supplier quoted in another one, delete this quote and enter it again.

photos.openCount: Open {count, plural, =1 {# supplier photo} other {# supplier photos}}
photos.attachHint: Add them now — they upload as soon as the price is saved. You can also add them later from the quote.
photos.waiting: {count, plural, =1 {# photo will be attached when you save} other {# photos will be attached when you save}}
photos.savedWithout: The quote from {supplier} is saved. These photos did not upload: {names}

noSupplier.title: No supplier found
noSupplier.hint: Yours alone. It says nobody you rang could supply this — a colleague may still find one.
noSupplier.mine: You have recorded that you could not source this.
noSupplier.mineWithNote: You have recorded that you could not source this: {note}

error.not_found: That tender item is no longer there.
error.not_assignee: Only an assignee can enter quotes on this tender. Add yourself to it first.
error.not_sourced_by_you: Only the assignee who sourced this quote, or the tender's owner, can change it.
error.clears_selection: This quote is the one selected for this item. Deleting it clears that selection — confirm below if that is what you want.
error.incomplete: Fill in the supplier and the unit the price is per.
error.invalid_price: Give a price greater than zero. If nobody would quote, record no supplier found instead.
error.invalid_lead_time: Lead time has to be a whole number of days, or left blank.
error.invalid_date: Check the quoted date — it is not a real day.
error.unsupported_currency: No published rate exists for that currency, so the price could not be converted. Ask the supplier to quote in one of the currencies offered.
error.alternative_unnamed: An alternative needs the name of the product the supplier actually priced.
error.no_rate: No exchange rate could be reached for that currency, and none has ever been stored. Try again in a moment, or enter the price in THB.
error.failed: That could not be saved. Try again.

header.undecided: {count, plural, =1 {# of {total} items still needs a quote selected} other {# of {total} items still need a quote selected}}
header.undecidedRest: They are open below; decided items are folded away.
header.allDecided: Every item has a selected quote.

referenceImages.label: Client reference images
referenceImages.open: Open {count, plural, =1 {# reference image} other {# reference images}} for {item}

pricing.landedCost: Cost to us / unit for {item}, in THB
pricing.hint: Add shipping, duty and handling. Saving confirms the cost.

error.not_found: That item is no longer on this tender.
error.invalid_amount: Enter an amount in THB, or leave it empty.
error.failed: Could not save the figure. Try again.

totals.coverage: {priced} of {total, plural, =1 {# item} other {# items}} priced

comparison.noQuotes: Nothing recorded against this item yet.
comparison.derivedNote: THB figures are derived for comparison only, at the rate frozen onto each quote when it was entered. Suppliers are paid in the currency they quoted.

quote.openPhotos: Open {count, plural, =1 {# photo} other {# photos}} from {supplier}

unitMismatch.title: Not ranked.
unitMismatch.body: Quotes arrived in units other than {unit}. Nothing here is ranked and nothing is marked lowest — converting pack sizes silently would highlight the wrong supplier.

allAlternatives.title: No exact match.
allAlternatives.body: {count, plural, =1 {# quote, and it is an alternative} other {# quotes, and all of them are alternatives}} to {product}. The ranking is comparing different products.

tooClose.title: Too close to call on frozen rates.
tooClose.body: {leader} leads {runnerUp} by {gap}%, but {supplier}'s rate was frozen on {date}. The gap is smaller than the drift between two rates frozen on different days — check both before choosing on price alone.

duplicateSupplier.title: The same supplier, quoted more than once.
duplicateSupplier.body: {supplier} quoted {prices} — every one kept, because the difference is the point.

error.not_found: That quote is no longer on this item.
error.failed: Could not record the selection. Try again.

people.title: People
people.description: Everyone in the org. Accounts exist only by invitation — there is no sign-up page.

status.sent: Invitation sent. They set their own password from the link.
status.already_invited: That address already has an account.
status.send_failed: The invitation could not be sent. Check the email settings.
status.incomplete: Enter both a name and an email address.

status.not_admin: Only an Administrator can change this.
status.not_found: That person is not in your org.
status.taken: Another member already has that userid.

status.sent: Posted to the group. Ask them to confirm they were @mentioned — WeCom accepts a wrong userid without complaint.
status.not_admin: Only an Administrator can send this.
status.not_found: That person is not in your org.
status.send_failed: WeCom would not take the message. Nobody was notified — try again.
status.no_robot: No WeCom group is set up yet, so nothing can be sent.

status.disabled: Disabled. They can no longer sign in, and they are gone from the Owner and Assignee pickers. Everything they own stays as it is.
status.readmitted: Restored. They can sign in again.
status.not_admin: Only an Administrator can change this.
status.not_found: That person is not in your org.
status.last_admin: This is the only Administrator. Somebody else has to be made one first, or nobody would be able to invite anyone again.
status.failed: That did not save. Try again.

groupRobot.title: WeCom group
groupRobot.description: The WeCom group every reminder, outcome and daily summary is posted through. One per org.
groupRobot.notConfigured: Not set up yet — nobody is being notified of anything.
groupRobot.label: Webhook URL
groupRobot.help: Copy it from the robot's settings in the WeCom group. Treat it like a password: anyone who has it can post to that group as this app. It is never shown again once saved.

status.saved: Saved. Send a test @mention from the People screen to check it reaches someone.
status.cleared: Removed. Nothing will be posted to the group until a new one is saved.
status.not_admin: Only an Administrator can change this.
status.not_a_wecom_webhook: That is not a WeCom group webhook. It should start https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/ and carry a key.
status.save_failed: That could not be saved. The webhook is unchanged — try again.

currencyConversion.title: Converting foreign prices
currencyConversion.description: A supplier quoting in yuan or dollars is converted to Baht at the market rate plus a little, because a bank charges more than the market rate. This sets how much is added.
currencyConversion.current: Foreign prices are being converted at the market rate plus {percent}%.
currencyConversion.label: Added to the market rate (%)
currencyConversion.help: Higher makes foreign prices look slightly dearer than the market says, which is the safe direction to be wrong in. Lower makes every bid look cheaper than it will really be.
currencyConversion.affects: Only quotes recorded from now on. A quote already recorded keeps the rate it was entered at — the one exception is somebody correcting the day a quote says the price was given, which works that day out afresh.

status.saved: Saved. Quotes recorded from now on use the new figure.
status.not_admin: Only an Administrator can change this.
status.not_a_percentage: That is not a number. Enter a percentage, such as 2 or 2.5.
status.out_of_range: Enter a percentage between 0 and 10. A 2 typed as 200 would treble every foreign price.
status.too_precise: Two decimal places at most — 2.25, not 2.255.
status.save_failed: That could not be saved. The figure is unchanged — try again.
